name: school-backend
description: School management system: five Node.js microservices behind an **nginx API gateway**, sharing a common library (`shared/`), backed by MySQL (one database per service), Redis (cache + refresh tokens + BullMQ), and JWT auth — all orchestrated with docker-compose.

scripts.up: npm run gateway:build && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.gateway:test: npm run gateway:build && docker compose exec -T nginx nginx -t
scripts.gateway:reload: npm run gateway:build && docker compose exec -T nginx nginx -s reload
scripts.verify: npm run gateway:check && npm run cache:map && npm run cache:selftest
